dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: Ah, when it comes to age, there's always someone older than me, and always someone younger.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: Really, I'm not that old, nor do I lament my age. Have you met that kid named Cadmael?

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: He's a few years younger than me, and I'm one of his maternal cousins by relation.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: Hasn't been smooth going for that kid lately, I'll tell you what.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: Hmm? Well, let's help big each other up, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: ...Yeah. But some might consider my concern one-sided.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: On the one hand, I hope he doesn't give up on flying tests so easily. After all, he's still young, and it's not as if he's talentless.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: But on the other hand, I don't want him to waste too much time failing and hope he can find a career for himself soon that will bring him a sense of both satisfaction and achievement.

dialogues.speaker: Copa
dialogues.text: You see, not even I can wrap my head around such life choices. If I ever figure it out, I'll go give him some guidance.
